title: Policy Refresh Clinic: What Changed in 2026
description: An annual update that translates new and cancelled guidance into what staff do differently on Monday. The 2026 edition covers the cancellation of TEGL 09-22 (youth flexibilities), the rescission of TEGL 10-23 Change 2 (work authorization), the new ETPL directive WSD25-02, AJCC certification under WSD25-05, the 90 percent OJT waiver, and the CalJOBS modernization.
notes: Audience: Policy staff, supervisors, all frontline staff. Format: LV (refreshed each program year). Hours assumed from format (LV = 3 hours).
learning_objectives: Identify local policies that still cite cancelled or superseded guidance.
Explain each 2026 change and its effect on frontline practice.
Update a local procedure or desk guide to match current rules.
Set up a routine for catching future directive changes.

sequencing_rationale: Lessons follow the catalog's learning objectives in the order a practitioner meets them on the job: Finding Policies That Cite Cancelled Guidance; The 2026 Changes and What They Mean on Monday; Updating a Local Procedure or Desk Guide; A Routine for Catching Future Directive Changes. The closing project ("Project: Refresh One Desk Guide") applies the earlier lessons to one realistic work product (a refreshed local procedure or desk guide with superseded citations replaced and a documented routine for tracking directive changes) rather than introducing new content. Scope assumptions: hours are not stated in the source catalog and are assumed from the delivery format (LV (refreshed each program year); LV = 3 hours). Content is grounded in California and federal guidance named in the catalog description and objectives; the course cites those directives by number but does not reproduce their text, and every policy-specific claim must be checked against the current directive before delivery. Local board policy is treated as a variable the learner fills in from their own board, not something the course prescribes.
